reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I can get a bigger bottle for less. Even the $24.99 launch price is only a bit above what I already pay, and I would wait for a flash sale or coupon anyway.

would_change_my_mind: A TikTok Shop flash sale or coupon that brings the first box to about $19 or less, or a cheap trial size.
